pr_title: Fix the wrong translation of the coordinate in X11 platform
pr_body:
Fix the wrong translation of the coordinate in DisplayServerX11::_window_changed.
Fix #75292
pr_comments:
Some extra info:

The issue seems to be random order of ChangeNofity, it is sent when window decoration is set and wine window is moved, order of events is random, and I do not see any way to tell them apart. Depending on the timing of events, `wd.position` might be set to a correct or incorrect value. So I'm not sure if it's possible to fix it at all.

@bruvzg During the processing of the ChangeNotify event, we are pulling the value for the position from XTranslateCoordinate which should give the accurate position of the window. Why there ever be a change in that?

I am trying to use gdb to debug this. I set a breakpoint to DisplayServerX11::window_set_position but it is not hitting it. Another thing I noticed is that in DisplayServerX11::window_set_position we are not changing the position of the window DisplayServerX11 side.

When showing a new window, ChangeNotify event is triggered 3–4 times with the different positions (some of these positions include decorations, others do not), I have no idea how to handle it.

For me, it is usually something like:
```
ChangeNotify wrong_pos
ChangeNotify wrong_pos
MapNotify
ChangeNotify wrong_pos
ChangeNotify correct_pos
```
(in this case, the issue does not happen, windows are positioned correctly).

But sometimes (rarely) it is:
```
ChangeNotify wrong_pos
MapNotify
ChangeNotify correct_pos
ChangeNotify wrong_pos
```
(in this case, issue is reproducible).

~After trying everything from changing the window to the override direct so the effect of the wm(which cannot be changed) and a few other things. I conclude I cannot solve this issue.~ Looks like someone solved this issue

@bruvzg  those ChangeNotify events are being sent by the window manager.  There is another thing we cannot restore the window position by XMoveWindow even with _NET_FRAME_EXTENDS. The reason for that is that window managers are reparenting the window thus we are losing the initial position of the window. In conclusion, we need to find the parent of the window and save it somewhere even some decoration reparent the reparented window( parenting Inception right there).

issue_context.title: Windows move downward by the height of their title bars each time they popup (DisplayServer regression)
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v4.0.1.stable.custom_build [cacf49999]

### System information

Fedora 37 (GNOME/X11)

### Issue description

Open and close the Editor Settings window repeatedly. Note how it moves downward each time it opens. I measured it, and it appears to move by exactly the height of the title bar each time. There is probably a window position calculation that does not account for the title bar height properly.

This issue does not happen with Single Window Mode enabled.

I have only tried this on GNOME with X11 as the windowing system.

### Steps to reproduce

See above

### Minimal reproduction project

N/A

review_comments: `position` is "client rect" origin not a window origin, it should not include decorations and will result in misplaced popups menus/other dropdowns. So this change seem to be wrong, and the issue should be somewhere else.
My Youcompleteplugin did that. I didn't realize it. My bad.
